items.text: Thereare two typesofmagnets that we use inour everyday lives.These arepermanent magnets and electromagnets. A permanent magnet hasa magnetic field around it all the time.The strength and direction of this field is not easy to change.An electromagnet when turned on also has a magnetic field around it but its strength and direction can be changed very easily.In this chapteryou will leamabout the factors affecting the magnetic field around anelectromagnet and howelectromagnets are used in several important devices.
